verdict.rationale: The evidence covers installation (interactive `npx skills add`, per-skill install, `yy skills install/update`) and flags differing or unrecorded copies for review. It does not document a feature that lists a skill's files, instructions or scripts before install, or a way to inspect every installed file afterward. Raw SKILL.md files being readable on GitHub is a host-platform property, and the copy-drift review flag is an adjacent control, so neither counts toward this story.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can review exactly what instructions and scripts a skill will add — list contents before installing and read every file afterward
